name: request_security_invalid_symbol_tuple_ignore_capture
source: Pyne-defined request.security invalid-symbol tuple ignore capture fixture
script:
indicator("Request Invalid Symbol Tuple Ignore Capture", overlay=True)
invalid_open, invalid_close = request.security(
    "BINANCE:PYNE_MISSING_SYMBOL",
    "240",
    ("open", "close"),
    gaps=barmerge.gaps_on,
    ignore_invalid_symbol=True,
)
plot(invalid_open, "Invalid Tuple Open")
plot(invalid_close, "Invalid Tuple Close")
plot(na(invalid_open), "Invalid Tuple Open Is NA")
plot(na(invalid_close), "Invalid Tuple Close Is NA")
plot(nz(invalid_open, -111), "Invalid Tuple Open Fallback")
plot(nz(invalid_close, -222), "Invalid Tuple Close Fallback")
pine_script:
//@version=5
_pyne_capture_bars = 12
_pyne_capture_use_last_bars = input.bool(true, "Pyne capture: use last chart bars")
_pyne_capture_start_time = input.int(1704067200000, "Pyne capture: start time (ms)")
_pyne_capture_invalid_symbol = input.string("BINANCE:PYNE_MISSING_SYMBOL", "Pyne capture: invalid symbol")
_pyne_capture_start_hit = time >= _pyne_capture_start_time and (na(time[1]) or time[1] < _pyne_capture_start_time)
_pyne_capture_from_time = ta.barssince(_pyne_capture_start_hit)
_pyne_capture_from_last = bar_index - (last_bar_index - _pyne_capture_bars)
_pyne_capture_index = _pyne_capture_use_last_bars ? _pyne_capture_from_last : _pyne_capture_from_time
_pyne_capture_active = _pyne_capture_index >= 0 and _pyne_capture_index < _pyne_capture_bars

indicator("Pyne Request Capture - Invalid Symbol Tuple Ignore", overlay=true)
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? _pyne_capture_index : na, "Pyne Capture Index")

[_invalid_open, _invalid_close] = request.security(_pyne_capture_invalid_symbol, "240", [open, close], gaps=barmerge.gaps_on, lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off, ignore_invalid_symbol=true)
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? _invalid_open : na, "Invalid Tuple Open")
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? _invalid_close : na, "Invalid Tuple Close")
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? (na(_invalid_open) ? 1 : 0) : na, "Invalid Tuple Open Is NA")
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? (na(_invalid_close) ? 1 : 0) : na, "Invalid Tuple Close Is NA")
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? nz(_invalid_open, -111) : na, "Invalid Tuple Open Fallback")
plot(_pyne_capture_active ? nz(_invalid_close, -222) : na, "Invalid Tuple Close Fallback")
